description: AI Talking Head — Generate Talking Head Videos from Text with AI Presenter. Turn any script into a talking head video without hiring a spokesperson or setting up a camera. Paste your text, pick a presenter style, and the AI generates a video with natural lip sync, gestures, and pacing. Use it for product walkthroughs, course intros, investor updates, FAQ pages, or internal training. Edit the result in chat: swap the background, adjust delivery speed, add subtitles, or insert the talking head clip into a longer video alongside screen recordings and slides. No green screen, no teleprompter, no retakes. Supports mp4, mov, webm, mkv output.
title_en: AI Video Editing — Describe It, Done
